name: Hand-drawn outline around the speaker
description: A hand-drawn orange line traces the speaker's head and shoulders: it draws around the person on the real picture, boiling on twos, two passes of ink, then fades out. Built from the person's matte, so it follows the body without touching the face.
use_when: A 2-4 second moment where the speaker is the subject: a strong opinion, a hook, 'this is me', a reaction. One or two per video, with a steady head position.

outline.help: kit/hf/tools/scribble.py output for this exact picture: {fps, steps: [[pass0_runs, pass1_runs], ...], width 540, height 960}
